features.name: age_scaled
features.description: Z-score normalized age using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth, zero-centered continuous feature ideal for linear SVM margins, preventing the age scale from dominating the regularization penalty.

features.name: education_scaled
features.description: Z-score normalized education_num using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the education level to a zero-centered scale, allowing the linear model to weigh education equally against other continuous features.

features.name: hours_scaled
features.description: Z-score normalized hours_per_week using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes working hours to improve gradient descent convergence and margin calculation in linear SVMs.

features.name: capital_net_log
features.description: Log-transformed net capital gain (gain minus loss, floored at zero) to handle extreme right-skewness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the massive range of capital gains into a smooth, roughly linear scale, preventing large outliers from distorting the SVM decision boundary.

features.name: capital_loss_log
features.description: Log-transformed capital loss to handle skewness and provide a continuous severity measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme capital loss values, providing a more stable continuous feature for linear projection.

features.name: age_education_interaction
features.description: Min-max normalized interaction term between age and education_num.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the combined effect of age and education in a single linear feature, allowing the linear SVM to approximate non-linear interactions.

features.name: hours_education_interaction
features.description: Min-max normalized interaction term between hours_per_week and education_num.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a composite feature representing the combination of high education and long working hours, useful for linear separation.

features.name: is_full_time_adult
features.description: Binary indicator for individuals aged 25 or older working at least 40 hours per week.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a sharp linear decision boundary feature for a common demographic segment, aiding the SVM margin.

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall financial stability based on age, education level, and capital gains/losses.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, continuous severity measure of financial health that a linear model can easily weight.

features.name: career_advancement_potential
features.description: Semantic evaluation of potential for career growth based on occupation type, education level, and age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes complex categorical relationships (occupation, education) into a single continuous score suitable for linear projection.

features.name: work_life_balance_indicator
features.description: Semantic assessment of work-life balance based on hours_per_week, marital_status, and relationship status.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates categorical family structures and continuous working hours into a unified linear feature.

features.name: demographic_representation_index
features.description: Semantic index assessing demographic representation based on race, sex, and native_country.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses multiple demographic categorical variables into a continuous index, reducing dimensionality for the linear SVM.
